scene.ko: 위층 이웃에게 밤늦은 소음을 정중히 이야기했다가 우리 집 TV 소리도 크다는 말을 듣고, 서로 지킬 방법을 정한다.

lines.en: Hi, I'm Sora from downstairs, in 2C. Is now a good time to talk?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 아래층 2C호에 사는 소라예요. 지금 잠깐 이야기 나눌 수 있을까요?
alt: Hi, I live right below you in 2C. Do you have a minute?
Hello, I'm Sora from 2C downstairs. Can we talk for a minute?

lines.en: Oh, hi. Sure. Is everything okay?
lines.ko: 아, 안녕하세요. 그럼요. 무슨 일 있으세요?

lines.en: I hope you don't mind me bringing this up, but I've been hearing loud footsteps and music after midnight.
lines.ko: 이런 얘기 꺼내도 괜찮을지 모르겠는데요, 자정이 넘어서 쿵쿵거리는 발소리랑 음악 소리가 들려서요.
alt: I'm sorry to bring this up, but there's been loud music and footsteps after midnight.
I don't want to cause any trouble, but I've been hearing music and footsteps late at night.

lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I work late, so I usually get home around midnight. I didn't realize it was that loud.
lines.ko: 아, 죄송해요. 제가 늦게까지 일해서 보통 자정쯤 집에 와요. 그렇게 시끄러운 줄 몰랐어요.

lines.en: I understand. I start work early, though, so it's been hard to get enough sleep.
lines.ko: 이해해요. 그런데 저는 아침 일찍 출근해서 잠을 충분히 자기가 힘들었어요.
alt: I see. I have to get up early for work, though, so I haven't been sleeping well.
That makes sense. But I start early, so I've had trouble sleeping.

lines.en: That's fair. Actually, since we're talking, your TV gets pretty loud in the evenings, too.
lines.ko: 그럴 만하네요. 그런데 말 나온 김에 말하자면, 저녁에는 그쪽 TV 소리도 꽤 커요.

lines.en: Oh, really? I had no idea. I'm sorry about that.
alt: Oh, I didn't know that. Sorry.
Really? I didn't realize. I apologize.

lines.en: No worries. How about this? I'll put down a rug and keep the music low after ten, and maybe you could turn your TV down a little?
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 이렇게 하면 어때요? 저는 러그를 깔고 열 시 이후에는 음악을 작게 틀게요. 그쪽은 TV 소리를 조금만 줄여 주시고요.

lines.en: That sounds like a good plan. I'll keep the volume down, and please let me know if it's ever too loud again.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 저도 소리를 줄일게요. 혹시 또 시끄러우면 꼭 말씀해 주세요.
alt: That sounds fair. I'll turn it down, and just tell me if it's ever too loud.
Deal. I'll keep the TV quieter. Please tell me if it bothers you again.

lines.en: Deal. And thanks for coming to talk to me in person.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그리고 직접 와서 얘기해 줘서 고마워요.

expressions.en: Is now a good time to talk?
expressions.ko: 지금 잠깐 이야기 나눌 수 있을까요?
expressions.note: 말을 꺼내기 전에 상대의 상황을 물을 때

expressions.en: I hope you don't mind me bringing this up, but ___.

expressions.note: 요즘 계속 힘든 점을 말할 때
I didn't know 보다 강한 말
